# Time 6242Y Grey 2.5mm² Twin & Earth Cable 100m Drum(75935)

(59)

Ask a Question

The Time 6242Y twin and earth cable is designed for ring main and socket outlet circuits in domestic installations. This 100m drum provides substantial length for larger projects without joins, reducing installation time and waste. Solid copper core wire maintains rigidity during routing, whilst the grey PVC sheath protects against damage and maintains performance from -15 to 70°C. The 2.5mm² conductor area meets standard UK requirements for domestic ring circuits, and the flat profile simplifies installation through conduit and behind skirting boards. Rated to 300/500V, it delivers reliable performance across typical household wiring applications.

*   Grey PVC Sheathed Cable
*   Brown & Blue Cores with Bare Earth
*   Solid Core Wire
*   Flat for Easy Installation
*   100m Drum Reduces Joins on Larger Projects
*   Solid Copper Core with 300/500V Rating
